selected_layer: triton kernel loop scheduling (GM load prefetch / double buffering)
layer_reason: Profiling shows both MTE2 and VECTOR below 40% busy with additive pipe times, negligible total traffic (24MB) and full-pass memory read reuse, and the IR shows a load-then-use loop with no second load in flight. The fix is therefore in how the existing loop issues loads, not in tile heuristics, launch shape or the reduction math.
simulator_incremental_judgment: Hotspots/regions add that the largest per-instruction contributions and the WAIT_FLAG/BAR entries sit inside the stats loop (lines 51-66, with addresses attached to lines 53/57) and that a single wait instruction reaches 6.64us, which localizes the exposed wait to the tile loop rather than to the epilogue reduction or the running-stat stores. The normalized timeline adds the split between VECTOR productive (0.49) and explicit wait_only (0.31), plus SCALAR wait_only 0.58 and low VECTOR idle (0.20), which argues against vector-throughput saturation and for load-use waiting; MTE2's high idle (0.69) shows the load pipe is not the sustained bottleneck either. These ratios are a partial-window fraction only, so they distinguish hypotheses but cannot prove the dependency or give device time; the prefetch experiment is the test that would confirm it.
